name: rebootPendingEndpointsCount
definition: The number of distinct endpoints in scope that have patches installed or staged and are waiting for a restart to finish applying them.
population: the endpoints in scope; every endpoint the read lists. The value counts the endpoints the read says are waiting for a reboot
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A complete read of every in-scope endpoint's patch or reboot state showing none waiting for a reboot (0). A response that carries no reboot indicator at all cannot show 0 and is not measured.
citations: safeguards/threat-vulnerability-management/connectwise-rmm/rebootPendingEndpointsCount.py (patch records of a remote monitoring tool; no public vendor document names the reboot field, so its spellings are unverified)
safeguards/threat-vulnerability-management/action1-com/rebootPendingEndpointsCount.py (an existing implementation; not reviewed for this entry)

changeLog.change: Registered so the remote-monitoring patch-state transform can emit it. The meaning is the key name made precise; the existing implementation in the same category was not reviewed, so the key stays proposed and V0.

notes: Registered for the ConnectWise RMM transform. A count of endpoints, lower is better, 0 only from a response that shows a reboot indicator on the records it read.
